# Contract: Landing Page

*Generated by spec-writer. Hand edits are overwritten on regeneration.*

## Prerequisites

These conditions describe the environment in which items in this contract are exercised. Producing them is part of the feature's deliverable, alongside the implementation itself - a contract whose prerequisites are not yet satisfied is not failing, it is still being built. Once the feature is delivered, any missing condition halts item execution until it is restored.

**Runtime services:**
- Next.js web app is started through `./scripts/init.sh` and is reachable at the configured local web origin. Used by: UI-PUBLIC-ROOT-01, UI-CREATE-ACCOUNT-01, UI-LOGIN-LINK-01, UI-VISUAL-IDENTITY-01, E2E-PUBLIC-ROOT-01, E2E-CREATE-ACCOUNT-01, E2E-LOGIN-LINK-01, E2E-AUTHENTICATED-REDIRECT-01.

**Configuration:**
- The web app serves the Next.js App Router root route at `/`.
- An F01-scoped test mechanism (test-only configuration flag, session-module override, or test cookie) can drive the web app's session check into an `authenticated` state without requiring any other feature's auth implementation. The mechanism MUST be available in the running web app under the same origin used for tests. Used by: E2E-AUTHENTICATED-REDIRECT-01.

## Quality gates

Each gate must pass for the feature to be considered ready.

- **Project lint** — `npm run lint` — Frontend and backend lint rules pass with the configured workspace scripts.
- **Project typecheck** — `npm run typecheck` — Frontend and backend TypeScript projects compile without type errors.
- **Project build** — `npm run build` — The Next.js app and backend service produce production builds.
- **Project tests** — `npm run test` — The existing automated test suite passes.
- **Backend architecture gates** — `./scripts/run-gates.mjs` — Backend type, lint, dependency, architecture, cycle, and unused-code gates pass through the provided wrapper.

## Coverage Manifest

| PRD Acceptance Criterion | Covered by |
|---|---|
| Page loads at `/` without requiring authentication | UI-PUBLIC-ROOT-01, E2E-PUBLIC-ROOT-01 |
| Primary "Create account" CTA links to `/register` | UI-CREATE-ACCOUNT-01, E2E-CREATE-ACCOUNT-01 |
| Top-right "Log in" link routes to `/login` | UI-LOGIN-LINK-01, E2E-LOGIN-LINK-01 |
| Authenticated users who visit `/` are redirected to `/app` | E2E-AUTHENTICATED-REDIRECT-01 |
| Visual design follows a minimalist, HubSpot-inspired style (generous white space, flat layout, restrained accent color) | UI-VISUAL-IDENTITY-01 |

## UI

**Verification mode:** Render the surface, drive it with user-like inputs (clicks, typing, gestures); assert observable surface state (DOM, accessibility tree, visible text, navigation).

### Public Root

#### `UI-PUBLIC-ROOT-01` - anonymous landing render
- given: no active browser session exists
- when: render the root URL `/`
- then:
  - the page shows the Videomax product name
  - the hero includes a one-sentence value proposition above the fold
  - the hero includes a supporting paragraph
  - the page includes a three-step "how it works" strip
  - the page includes a footer

### Create Account

#### `UI-CREATE-ACCOUNT-01` - primary CTA target
- given: no active browser session exists
- when: render the root URL `/`
- then:
  - a prominent link or button has visible text "Create account"
  - the primary "Create account" action targets `/register`
  - the primary action is visible above the fold on a desktop viewport

### Login Link

#### `UI-LOGIN-LINK-01` - returning-user link target
- given: no active browser session exists
- when: render the root URL `/`
- then:
  - the header navigation contains visible text "Log in"
  - the "Log in" action targets `/login`
  - the "Log in" action is positioned in the top-right navigation area on a desktop viewport

### Visual Identity

#### `UI-VISUAL-IDENTITY-01` - minimalist style review
- given: no active browser session exists
- when: render the root URL `/` at desktop and mobile viewport widths
- then:
  - the layout uses generous whitespace around the hero content
  - the page uses flat sections without heavy photographic imagery
  - the primary CTA uses a restrained accent color
  - typography has a clear hierarchy between navigation, hero, body copy, and step labels
  - text remains readable without overlapping neighboring UI
- notes: subjective; manual review only

## E2E

**Verification mode:** Run the full system; drive it the way a real user would; assert cross-stack behavior.

### Public Root

#### `E2E-PUBLIC-ROOT-01` - anonymous route access
- given: no active browser session exists
- when: navigate to `/`
- then:
  - the browser remains on `/`
  - the page displays the Videomax landing hero
  - no login form is required before viewing the page

### Create Account

#### `E2E-CREATE-ACCOUNT-01` - CTA navigation
- given: no active browser session exists and the root URL `/` is open
- when: activate the primary "Create account" action
- then:
  - the browser navigates to `/register`

### Login Link

#### `E2E-LOGIN-LINK-01` - login navigation
- given: no active browser session exists and the root URL `/` is open
- when: activate the top-right "Log in" action
- then:
  - the browser navigates to `/login`

### Authenticated Redirect

#### `E2E-AUTHENTICATED-REDIRECT-01` - returning user bypasses landing
- given: the browser session has been driven into an `authenticated` state via the F01-scoped test mechanism (no dependency on any other feature's auth implementation)
- when: navigate to `/`
- then:
  - the browser navigates to `/app`
  - the public landing hero is not displayed after navigation settles
